description: Phase 19 per-module coverage ratchet enforced by scripts/coverage-report.ps1. Inputs: merged coverlet.collector (XPlat Code Coverage, Cobertura) reports of Template.Unit.Tests, Template.Integration.Tests and Template.Functional.Tests. Minimums = floor(measured - 1) of the coverlet 10.1.0 baseline measured on 2026-10-12 (line and method data identical in three runs); minimumSources = measured source files after exclusions. Phase 21 (2026-10-14, owner-approved): Application minimumSources 41->40 and WebApi 32->31 after removing the dead ApiErrorResponse.cs and ApiResultFilterAttribute.cs, Application line raised 93->94 from the measured 95.12%. Raise the numbers when coverage improves; lowering one weakens the gate and needs explicit justification and approval. Phase 25 (2026-10-18): Template.Infrastructure.Integrations added (line 94, branch 83, 9 sources from the measured 95.35%/84.26%); Application raised to line 96/branch 90 (measured 97.76%/91.47%) and every minimumSources raised to the measured count (Domain 27, Application 87, Identity 18, Persistence 22, WebApi 59); nothing lowered. Phase 27 (2026-10-20): minimumSources raised to the measured counts after the budgeting and requisition modules (Domain 37, Application 99, Persistence 26, WebApi 63); measured Domain 99.52% line, Application 97.97%/90.71%; thresholds unchanged, nothing lowered. Phase 29 (2026-10-23): minimumSources raised to the measured counts after the sourcing module (Domain 42, Application 109, Messaging 15, Persistence 31, WebApi 65); measured Domain 99.75% line, Application 97.48%/90.14%; thresholds unchanged, nothing lowered. Phase 30 (2026-10-23): Template.Infrastructure.Files (line 75, branch 78, 5 sources from the measured 76.96%/79.73%; the blob adapter's network paths are proven by the opt-in Azurite suite, which is not part of the merged coverage) and Template.Infrastructure.Reporting (line 92, branch 87, 4 sources from the measured 93.92%/88.97%) added; minimumSources raised to the measured counts (Domain 44, Application 121, Persistence 33, WebApi 68); measured Domain 99.72% line, Application 97.78%/90.39%; thresholds unchanged, nothing lowered. Phase 31 (2026-10-24): Template.Infrastructure.Workflow (line 97, branch 91, 4 sources from the measured 98.04%/92.86%) and Template.WorkflowFunctions (line 16, branch 35, 9 sources from the measured 17.18%/36.99%; the orchestrator branches are covered by the scripted-context tests and the HTTP functions, activities and host by the opt-in emulator suite on the real Functions host, which is not part of the merged coverage) added; Template.WorkflowFunctions.Tests joins the merged inputs; minimumSources raised to the measured counts (Domain 46, Application 132, Identity 19, Persistence 35, WebApi 71); measured Domain 99.2% line, Application 97.83%/90.01%, Identity 93.87%/81.76%; thresholds unchanged, nothing lowered.
